info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Retrieval API allows users to access details about fiduciary agreements within the banking and deposit-lending domain. This endpoint retrieves specific fiduciary agreement information based on a unique identifier provided by the user. It is designed for banking professionals, compliance officers, and legal teams who require up-to-date records for audits, regulatory compliance, or customer inquiries. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure they have the necessary transparency and documentation for fiduciary relationships.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific fiduciary agreement identified by its ID. It provides all relevant information associated with the fiduciary agreement for your reference.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a specific fiduciary agreement based on the provided identifier. The response will include detailed information about the fiduciary agreement and its associated operations.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the fiduciary agreement details.
